title: Spreading elementary generator changes
statement: Let X be a scheme and f,g two finite tuples of global sections defining the same ideal sheaf. Each x in X has an open neighbourhood U on which the actual restricted tuples are connected by the elementary chain of [lem-pur-generating-tuple-chain].

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood and evaluate the ideal-sheaf identity there, obtaining equality of spans. Map this equality to the local ring at the chosen point and apply [lem-pur-generating-tuple-chain].

Lift each coefficient germ to a neighbourhood. A unit germ lifts to a section invertible after shrinking. Restrict all earlier operations when shrinking and induct over the finite chain. Equality of the finitely many endpoint germs spreads after a final finite intersection of neighbourhoods.

proof_origin.place: Local-ring and spreading paragraph, realized explicitly in Lean

mathlib_searches.query: finite generating tuples over a local ring joined by elementary operations and spread to scheme neighbourhoods
mathlib_searches.results: No direct statement; use the project local generator theorem and Mathlib stalk APIs.
Mathlib.Topology.Sheaves.Stalks.exists_le_germ_eq and RingedSpace.isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ supply the local lifting steps; no assembled chain theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem generatingTupleChain_of_idealSheaf_eq (X : Scheme.{u}) (c : ℕ)
    (f g : Fin c → Γ(X, ⊤))
    (hfg : Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) =
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (Ideal.span (Set.range g)) : X.IdealSheafData))
    (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_hxU : x ∈ U),
      Relation.ReflTransGen (Module.GeneratingTupleStep (R := Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)))
        (fun k ↦ U.ι.appTop (f k)) (fun k ↦ U.ι.appTop (g k))
